title: Descriptor-only native96 for unified operation closure
question: Do the integrated operation/cancellation, alias reporting and analysis preparation changes require only an append-only descriptor provenance transition, preserving native policy and replaying to an empty current candidate?
method: Use authenticated PgAdmin-owned disposable databases. Rehearse the single descriptor transition and exact native admission inside an outer rollback; compare unchanged catalog policy and hash every predecessor. Freeze byte-bound successor96 without editing predecessors; replay a fresh96 deployment, repeated upgrade, and empty candidate.

outputs.role: candidate, predecessor identities and rollback rehearsal

results.name: changed_inputs
results.note: Exact names and hashes are retained in author-001

conclusion: Frozen96 changes only execution_contract_descriptor model/input provenance for the integrated UM implementations. Catalog properties, privileges and guard policy are unchanged; all predecessor files retain their exact bytes. Exact admission holds before/after rollback and fresh96 replay has an empty candidate. This establishes bounded native provenance, not operational database adoption, cancellation behavioral qualification, PDF/provider acceptance or performance.
